1-10.title: Fetch
1-10.fullText: Stage 1 Biff and Chip Story Books Fetch! This story is called Fetch! Written by Roderick Hunt and illustrated by Alex Brickta. When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Let's look at the pictures together and see what will happen in this story. One windy afternoon, Mom took Biff and Chip to the park when she took Floppy out for his daily walk. Fetch it, Wolf, said an old lady. Oh, look at the dog! Mom, Biff, and Chip wanted Floppy to jump into the lake and fetch the stick. Go fetch a stick, Floppy, said Mom. Go on, fetch! Biff threw one more stick, but a gust of wind blew her hat off, and it went flying off into the lake. Oh, dear, said Mom. Suddenly, Floppy ran towards the lake. Floppy rescued Biff's hat, said Mom. What a good dog! Floppy looked really proud of himself.

1-12.title: The Apple
1-12.fullText: Stage 1 Biff and Chip Story Books The Apple This story is called The Apple written by Roderick Hunt and illustrated by Alex Brickta. When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Let's look at the pictures together and see what will happen in this story. Dad, Mom, Biff and Chip looked at an apple on the top of the tree. It's on the top of the tree. Let's pick. Dad stood on tiptoe and stretched up. Right there. We need to make him taller. Chip sat on Dad's shoulders and Mom handed him the stick. Ouch! Ouch! said Dad. Almost there. Come on, Chip. Chip put the end of the stick under the stalk of the apple and gently pushed it upwards. Then the apple fell. Catch it, Mom! shouted Chip. Catch it, Biff! shouted Mom. Catch it, Kipper! shouted Mom and Biff. Floppy crunched it into three pieces and began to chew one of the pieces up. Oh, Floppy! said Mom. Oh! He was the only one of you who could catch!

When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Let's read the story together. Dad had a map. He hit the map in the sand. Biff found the map. It is a treasure map, she said. The map said, Dick here. Dick here, said Biff. Chip dug in the sand. Well, Chip found a box. Is it a box of treasure? She said, No, it was a box of sweets.

When you hear this sound, turn the page. Now open the book. Let's read the story together. Chip had a box. This is my robot. He said, Can you see it? This is a leg. Said Chip. Can you see the robot? This is an arm. Said Chip. Can you see my robot? Can you see it yet? Said Chip. No. Said Biff. This is the head. Said Chip. Now can you see my robot? We can see it now. Said Biff.

segments.text: Can you see it? This is a leg.
